title: NAPCO Security Technologies Appoints Stephen Connor as National Accounts Manager, West
summary: NAPCO Security Technologies, Inc. is pleased to announce the appointment of Stephen Connor as National Accounts Manager, West. Bringing more than 20 years of experience in the security and technology industries, Connor will play a key role in expanding NAPCO's national accounts program, strengthening strategic partnerships, and driving business growth throughout the Western United States.
body_markdown:
For Immediate Release
November 18, 2026
NAPCO Security Technologies, Inc.
333 Bayview Avenue
Amityville, NY 11701
1-800-645-9445


**AMITYVILLE, N.Y.** – NAPCO Security Technologies, Inc. is pleased to announce the appointment of Stephen Connor as National Accounts Manager, West. Bringing more than 20 years of experience in the security and technology industries, Connor will play a key role in expanding NAPCO's national accounts program, strengthening strategic partnerships, and driving business growth throughout the Western United States.


In his new role, Connor will develop and manage key national account relationships, identify new business opportunities, strengthen customer engagement, and expand adoption of NAPCO's comprehensive range of security solutions, including intrusion and commercial fire systems, cloud-based access control, electronic locking, and cellular communications.


Connor brings extensive industry experience, having held senior leadership positions with several prominent security and technology companies. His background spans strategic sales, product management, marketing, and business development, with a strong focus on access control, biometric authentication, intrusion systems, and emerging security technologies. Throughout his career, he has successfully led product development initiatives, managed multimillion-dollar product portfolios, and supported the growth of security solutions across commercial and enterprise markets.


Connor will report directly to David Sperber, Vice President of National Accounts, and work closely with NAPCO's regional sales teams and technical specialists to deliver coordinated sales support and help customers identify security solutions tailored to their business needs.


"Stephen brings a unique combination of security industry knowledge, technical expertise, and business development experience that will be a tremendous asset to our national accounts team” said David Sperber, Vice President of National Accounts.


Connor's appointment reflects NAPCO's ongoing investment in its national sales organization and commitment to providing customers with dedicated expertise, innovative technologies, and responsive support. By strengthening its national accounts team, NAPCO continues to help security professionals capitalize on new opportunities and deliver comprehensive, integrated security solutions.


Contact Stephen Connor via email atsconnor@napcosecurity.com or call 631-263-9749. For more information about NAPCO Security Technologies, visit[www.napcosecurity.com](https://napcosecurity.com/) .


***About NAPCO Security Technologies, Inc.** Since 1969, NAPCO Security Technologies has focused on developing innovative solutions for security professionals. Through its NAPCO, Alarm Lock, Marks USA and NAPCO Access divisions, the company offers a comprehensive portfolio of commercial fire and intrusion systems, alarm communications, electronic and mechanical locking, and access control solutions, with deployment options spanning mobile-first, cloud, hybrid and on-premises enterprise applications.*
